rss: Stock up on food to prepare for extreme weather, minister says
title: Get Ready for Rainy Weather!
story: A cool weather event might make it rainy this winter. Everyone is stocking up on yummy cereal and juice.
storyBig: Meteorologists predict that a significant weather event could lead to prolonged stormy conditions this winter. Families are encouraged to stock up on essential food items like cereal and juice to prepare for possible disruptions.
think: What would you stock up on for a rainy day?
bull: Rainy days are great for board games!
bear: Too much rain can make outdoor play tricky.

rss: Xbox caps cloud gaming at 15 hours a month for Game Pass subscribers
title: Game Time Cut Short!
story: PIXL video games has set a limit on how long kids can play online each month. They want to make sure games run smoothly.
storyBig: PIXL video games has announced a new cap on monthly online gaming time to manage rising operational costs. This strategic move is intended to ensure an improved gaming experience for all users.
think: How would you spend your extra time if gaming hours were limited?
bull: Less screen time means more time for other fun!
bear: Some kids might miss playing their favorite games longer.
